name: Maxime Labonne
fame_basis: Author of the widely starred LLM Course on GitHub and of the books LLM Engineer's Handbook and Hands-On Graph Neural Networks Using Python; about 7,400 GitHub and 9,200 Hugging Face followers.
bio: Maxime Labonne is Head of Post-Training at Liquid AI and holds a PhD in machine learning from the Polytechnic Institute of Paris. They publish open models and educational material, including the LLM Course and several books.
known_for: Open merged and abliterated models on Hugging Face
